confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors rest on crowd-sourced Numbeo-style aggregates that disagree by up to about 2x (cappuccino ranged from about $1.9 to $5.6), so they are medium confidence. Accommodation is low confidence: the sources conflict, and the 3-star figure relies on a Trip.com average and Georgia-wide lari data rather than a Tbilisi double-room rate. Hostel prices were set with July peak season in mind. The cocktail anchor is a bounded estimate of roughly 2.4 times the beer anchor, a relationship chosen by judgement and not sourced directly. The wine glass anchor is a local price judgement, not sourced. The FX observation comes from a search-result snippet that attributes the 15 October 2026 AUD/USD value of 0.6955 to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page or the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Tbilisi is treated as a Caucasus tourist city in the Eastern European price band. Anchors come from Tbilisi-specific restaurant and drink aggregates, Tbilisi hostel listing averages, and Trip.com and Georgia-wide 3-star hotel data converted to USD.
